description: Actual outward reach to an external source. Third event in the four-step egress lineage. MUST reference an active egress-permission-grant via grant_sha. Seals the request payload (request_sha) at the moment of wire-touch, enabling replay-audit.

grant_sha.description: sha_seal of the authorizing egress-permission-grant. chain-invalid if missing or expired.

request_sha.description: sha256 of the canonical-form outgoing request payload (URL + headers + body)

cause.description: gap_id this reach fills, or null for play register
